svg.text: AI HYPERCOMPUTER CONTROL PLANE: GKE (KUEUE TAS + JOBSET + DWS) VS. SLURM & 3-TIER STORAGE
Kueue TAS + JobSet + DWS/Reservation + Hyperdisk ML + Orbax Async Hits 96.8% Goodput
1,024-Chip Cluster (4.2TB Checkpoint): Tier 1 Vanilla K8s + Sync GCS (54.5% Goodput, $2.48M/mo) vs. Tier 4 ($980K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Gang Deadlocks & 185s Ckpt Stalls
1. Partial Allocation Deadlocks & 10-Min DWS Timeout (28% Waste):
• Vanilla K8s schedules 220/256 pods & deadlocks; slow 25GB image
pulls miss DWS Flex-Start's strict 10-minute consumption window!
2. Confusing Billing CUDs with Capacity Reservations + COMPACT:
• Buying a 3-Yr CUD without a Specific Reservation + `COMPACT`
placement scatters nodes across subblocks (+22% AllReduce lag)
3. Synchronous Uncached GCS FUSE Checkpoints (185s Freeze):
• Writing 4.2TB synchronously over raw GCS FUSE stalls 1,024 chips
Production Failure Impact (1,024-Chip Training Cluster):
• End-to-End Cluster Goodput: Only 54.5% (45.5% wasted compute!)
• Checkpoint Freeze Time: 185.0 Seconds | Deadlock Waste: 28.0%
• Monthly 1,024-Chip Compute & Storage TCO: $2,480,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Kueue TAS + JobSet + DWS + 3-Tier Storage
1. Kueue 4-Object Model + Topology-Aware Scheduling (TAS) + JobSet:
• Maps `ResourceFlavor` (`Reservation COMPACT` base + `DWS Flex-Start`
burst with 7-day auto-checkpoint rotation) + subblock-pinned Gang
2. 3-Tier Storage (`Hyperdisk ML + Cached GCS FUSE + Lustre`):
• Streams base weights via `Hyperdisk ML` (1.2 TB/s) + shards
training data via `GCS FUSE + Local NVMe SSD Cache`
3. Orbax Two-Phase Async + Local-NVMe Emergency Checkpointer:
• Cuts 4.2TB save stall to `2.4s` & saves preempt state in `<5s`
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• End-to-End Cluster Goodput: 96.8% (+42.3 pts vs. Tier 1)
• Checkpoint Stall: 2.4 Seconds | Gang Deadlock Waste: 0.0%
• Monthly Total TCO: $980,000 / mo (-60.5% savings vs. Tier 1)
